annotations.title: Tony Ann Arpeggio Ripple & Syncopated Pedaling
annotations.instruction: Do not play these 16th notes percussively. Keep your wrist supple and rotate gently from pinky to thumb like water flowing over stones.
annotations.wristGuidance: Keep a relaxed, low wrist. Allow your arm to glide horizontally across the Abmaj7 and Bb chord shifts without hopping.

pedalGuidance.explanation: Hold the damper pedal throughout each measure, lifting smoothly right as the bass root strikes the keybed.

annotations.title: Climax: Full Arm Weight & Octave Stamina
annotations.instruction: Drop your full arm weight from the shoulder into the deep Ab1 and C2 octaves. Let the piano soundboard roar with sympathetic resonance.
annotations.handTechnique: Keep your thumb and pinky firm (an arch of steel) while keeping the wrist flexible to absorb the shock of fortissimo chords.
